summary: Validated Client Management page redesign: (1) new /api/clients/election-summary endpoint with correct role gating and count math, (2) top stats reduced to exactly two cards (Total Clients, Needs Decision) with old Active/Inactive/Platforms removed, (3) new Campaign Decisions column rendering opted-in/opted-out pills and amber pending indicator, (4) counts match backend and regressions (search, Client Manager My/All toggle, admin CRUD action buttons) intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js: needsDecisionCount depends on both `clients` and `summary`; on initial render summary loads asynchronously so the 'Needs Decision' card can flash 0 for a moment. Consider gating the number until both fetches resolve (or compute pending server-side per client to avoid divergence).

Backend /api/clients/election-summary returns summaries only for clients that have at least one election row. Clients with zero elections are absent from the map — the frontend correctly falls back to `pending = total_campaigns` via clientDecisions(), but the API contract would be clearer if it returned a zeroed entry per client_id (or accepted a client_ids filter). Documented behaviour was fine for the current UI.

server.py has grown to 1240+ lines. The election/campaign/client routes should be extracted into routers/*.py modules; also route ordering (/clients/election-summary before /clients/{client_id}) is fragile — an explicit APIRouter split would prevent accidental shadowing.
GET /api/clients/election-summary iterates elections in Python and does an unbounded to_list(1000000). Move opt_in/opt_out aggregation into MongoDB with an $group pipeline for scale.
Frontend derives BACKEND_URL from window.location.origin, ignoring REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in .env. Fine for prod but breaks local dev if the app is served on a different origin than the API.
seed_data_creation: None. The election-update regression test snapshots + restores the original decision to preserve seed state (4 users, 4 campaigns, 3 clients, Meridian opt_in and Surest opt_out on Global Winter Push).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_election_summary.py (env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL required for bare pytest). Frontend testids on /clients: dashboard-stats, stat-total-clients, stat-needs-decision (no stat-active/stat-inactive/stat-platforms anymore); per-row: client-row-<id>, client-decisions-<id>, opted-in-<id>, opted-out-<id>, needs-decision-<id> (only when pending>0). Admin observed on /clients: Total=3, Needs=3; Meridian 2 in / 1 out / 1 pending, Surest 0 in / 1 out / 3 pending, UHC 0 in / 0 out / 4 pending — matches E1's manual check. Client Manager sees only 2 (My scope) with toggle visible. Marketer receives 403 on /api/clients/election-summary.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature meets spec across all four roles and math invariant (opt_in + opt_out + pending == total_campaigns) holds.
